name: MEMERAG
description: MEMERAG is a multilingual end-to-end meta-evaluation benchmark for retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems. It uses native-language questions and expert human annotations for faithfulness and relevance to support development of automatic evaluators that correlate well with human judgment across multiple languages.
reputation: A newly proposed multilingual RAG meta-evaluation benchmark that is still emerging and not yet broadly established in the community.
notes: Focuses on native-language data to capture cultural nuances; supports benchmarking of multilingual automatic evaluators.
